forms.title: 504 Home Repair Loan and Grant Program Intake Form
forms.purpose: An intake to begin USDA review; not a complete eligibility determination, approved grant, or submitted application.
eligibility: Must own and occupy the home.
Property must be in an eligible rural area; USDA address eligibility tool and local office determine coverage.
Must be unable to obtain affordable credit elsewhere.
Household income must meet the applicable county low or very-low income limits.
Grants require age62 or older and very-low household income and must remove health/safety hazards.
Loans may repair, improve or modernize the home or remove health/safety hazards.
Final eligibility, documentation, funding and approval are determined by Rural Development; do not guarantee assistance or pipe-replacement coverage.
